text: opencode-omo 是面向 DSH Web 的代理预设，将 OpenCode 的提示与工具工作流和 omo 的多角色编排组合到一个可选模式中。它通过 DSH bundle 注册预设，并在输入框提供角色选择器、在设置页提供逐角色模型与回退配置。主要功能包括按角色切换提示和模型、委派专业子代理、提供代码导航工具，以及注入项目指令和规则。适合希望在 DSH 中使用角色化编码与计划工作流的用户。LSP 导航需另行安装 TypeScript 语言服务器。

opencode-omo adds an OpenCode and omo inspired agent mode to DSH Web. Choose roles in the composer, set per-role models and fallbacks, delegate to specialists, and use code navigation and project instructions. LSP navigation optionally needs TypeScript language server packages.
想在 DSH 里按不同编码角色切换代理提示。
让每个代理角色使用各自指定的模型和备用模型。
我想从对话输入框选择计划或执行角色。
需要把任务委派给研究、探索或审查类子代理。
希望编码代理能使用类似 OpenCode 的工具工作流。
能否在编辑代码时调用 LSP 查定义和引用？
I want role based coding agents with separate model choices.
Let me switch agent personas from the chat composer.
opencode-omo 提供输入框角色选择功能：在 DSH 对话输入框的角色菜单中选择主要代理角色；选择会保存到当前会话，并在角色指定主模型时切换会话模型。
opencode-omo 提供逐角色模型设置：在设置面板中为角色选择跟随当前模型、使用 omo 默认模型或固定模型，也可添加备用模型；更改通过设置表单保存。
opencode-omo 提供角色提示与模型路由：代理循环按当前选择组装对应角色的完整提示，并在请求错误时沿角色回退模型链继续尝试。
opencode-omo 提供代码导航工具：将定义跳转、查找引用、跳转实现和悬停信息映射到 DSH 的 LSP 查询接口，供代理查看代码符号信息。
opencode-omo 使用宿主补丁才能完整复现请求上限提示；未打补丁的 DSH 仍加载预设，但会改用系统提示回退方式。
opencode-omo 的 LSP 导航是可选功能，需单独安装 typescript-language-server 和 typescript；缺少时预设仍可加载，但导航工具不可用。

@royenheart/dsh-plugin-opencode-omo README · @royenheart/dsh-plugin-opencode-omo：[](https://github.com/royenheart/dsh-plugin-opencode-omo/tree/dsh-migrate/state)

A DeepSeek Harness plugin that adds an `opencode-omo` agent preset (mode) to the web profile. The mode replicates the behavior of **opencode** + the **omo** plugin ([oh-my-openagent](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent)), scoped to this mode only — other presets (`standard`/…) keep the default dsh loop, sandboxed fs, and no omo hooks.

@royenheart/dsh-plugin-opencode-omo README · Layout：```
cordis.patch.yml                 # bundle patch: host row + official agent-preset declaration
patches/                         # dsh-side patch(es) still required for the complete surface
install.py                       # idempotent install/uninstall (manifest + missing runtime/LSP links)
src/                             # host + client plugin halves (role registry, settings, picker UI)

@royenheart/dsh-plugin-opencode-omo README · Install：`lib/` is generated locally and is not committed. `install.py` always builds the repository's own toolchain first (`npm ci` when the toolchain is missing or `package-lock.json` is newer than the installed lock, then `npm run build`) and exits with an actionable error if npm, the build, the artifacts, or a required harness link is missing:

```sh
python3 install.py install --profile web              # install (idempotent)
python3 install.py uninstall --profile web            # remove
```

@royenheart/dsh-plugin-opencode-omo README · Install：`install.py` symlinks the package into `~/.dsh/profiles/<profile>/node_modules/`, mirrors runtime packages only when absent, ensures/repoints the LSP links (refusing real directories), and edits the profile's `package.json` (adds/removes the dependency + bundle entry). The bundle patch declares both the host row and the official `@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-preset` row, so there is no separate user-preset-root copy.

@royenheart/dsh-plugin-opencode-omo README · Install：Manual alternative — the package is a dsh **bundle**: it declares `dsh.bundle.patch` and ships the preset. `dsh plugin` reconciles `dsh.profile.bundles` from the installed package automatically:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add link:/path/to/dsh-plugin-opencode-omo
```

The bundle patch declares the official `@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-preset` row for `opencode-omo`, so no `$DSH_HOME/.agent-presets` copy is published. Restart dsh and select **opencode-omo** from the mode picker.

@royenheart/dsh-plugin-opencode-omo README · Install：**Upgrading from the pre-0.2.1 row id.** Existing profiles used the
`opencode-omo-roles` settings entry; rc.2's legacy importer preserves that
unknown entry in `$DSH_HOME/settings.yaml.imported`. On boot the host row reads that backup once per profile and merges its
role/session maps into the active `opencode-omo` entry, so old role models and
fallbacks are not silently reset. Profiles migrated by the pre-release
`9ad557c` home-global marker may re-import once because that marker had no
profile identity; review the merged roles after upgrading.

@royenheart/dsh-plugin-opencode-omo README · Install：**Optional LSP server.** The preset preconfigures `typescript-language-server` for the `lsp_*` navigation tools. `install.py` checks `PATH` and warns when it is missing; the optional LSP module then mounts without a provider so the mode still loads (LSP queries fail gracefully instead of blocking the whole preset). Install it to enable LSP:

```sh
npm install -g typescript-language-server typescript
```

then restart dsh.

@royenheart/dsh-plugin-opencode-omo README · Install：**web_fetch provider.** The preset enables dsh's native `web_fetch` tool (`fetch: true`). Official 0.2.1 already registers `@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-fetch-http` in the base bundle, so this plugin does **not** insert a second fetch row (that would throw `WEB_DUPLICATE_PROVIDER`). `web_search` keeps using the existing DeepSeek search provider (`DEEPSEEK_API_KEY`). Other presets keep `fetch: false`, so their tool surface is unchanged.

@royenheart/dsh-plugin-opencode-omo README · Required dsh-side changes：One patch is still required for the complete opencode surface:

`patches/0001-agent-pre-step-assistant-prefill.patch` (rebased onto
`dsh-v0.2.1-rc.2`) adds `PreStepDecision.assistantPrefill`, a request-only
assistant tail. The loop logs it on `request/header`, appends it to exactly the
request that asked for it, and prices it in token pressure; it is never a
session `assistant/message`, so transcript, compaction, and stats stay clean.

@royenheart/dsh-plugin-opencode-omo README · Required dsh-side changes：**Why the patch is still required.** opencode appends `MAX_STEPS_PROMPT` as an
assistant-role continuation on the ceiling step. Official 0.2.1
`PreStepDecision` is still `reject | { kind: 'enter', messages, startsRequestSeries? }`,
and `agent/request` cannot mutate request messages, so no official extension
point can express a request-only assistant tail. Upstream request:
[discussion #2407](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/2407).

@royenheart/dsh-plugin-opencode-omo README · Required dsh-side changes：The plugin probes the runtime capability
(`ctx.agentLoop.supportsAssistantPrefill`). On a patched host the ceiling text is
an assistant tail and no system-prompt section is added. On a stock host it
keeps the same text and trigger as a system-prompt section (see the fallback
table below); that is survivability, not the complete opencode surface.

@royenheart/dsh-plugin-opencode-omo README · Fallback on unpatched hosts：| Surface | opencode / patched harness | This plugin on a stock 0.2.1 host |
|---|---|---|
| Role of `MAX_STEPS_PROMPT` | Assistant-role continuation at the end of the request | System-prompt section for that step |
| Session transcript / stats / compaction | Request-only (header), not a session message | Also not a session message (system section is reassembled) |
| How strictly models stop / wrap up | Tuned for an assistant tail | May treat a system reminder more weakly or more strongly |
| Token placement | Extra assistant tokens on that request | Extra system tokens on that request |
| Reconstructable requests | Logged on `request/header` | Rebuilt from the live prompt assembly |

@royenheart/dsh-plugin-opencode-omo README · Fallback on unpatched hosts：The fallback is selected at runtime; the patch is not dropped when a host can
run without it.

Provider-visible `format`/`toolChoice` remains an unpatched proposal; omo's
regular path does not use it.

Everything else runs on unmodified dsh seams: the preset is declared by the
official `@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-preset` row, the role picker occupies the
existing `conversation.input.left` slot, and role settings use the official
settings form Remote.

@royenheart/dsh-plugin-opencode-omo README · Bench experiments (equivalence validation)：Runners and reproduction notes live in [`tests/benches/`](tests/benches/README.md); reports are written to `docs/exps/`. The scientific methodology (paired design, McNemar/bootstrap/TOST, A/A noise floor, trace alignment, cache and latency protocols) is documented in [`docs/exps/2026-08-16-scientific-bench-methodology.md`](docs/exps/2026-08-16-scientific-bench-methodology.md). Design highlights:

@royenheart/dsh-plugin-opencode-omo README · Bench experiments (equivalence validation)：- Run an isolated-port dsh (`opencode-omo` mode, isolated `$DSH_HOME`) and the machine's installed opencode + oh-my-openagent (isolated `XDG_CONFIG_HOME`).
- Both use `deepseek-official/deepseek-v4-pro` (dpsk v4 pro); the API key comes from the `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY` environment variable. Scripts hardcode no machine paths or secrets.
- Tiered benches: L1 HumanEval, L2 MBPP, L3 SWE-bench-verified-mini (sampled), comparing pass@1, CoT/reasoning exposure, tool-call chains (read/edit/write/bash/test/subagents), and final patches/answers.
- Performance: `bench_metrics.mjs` normalizes token usage (including `cacheRead`) and tool timestamps on both sides; `eval_perf.mjs` / `eval_swe_perf.mjs` produce cache hit rate, TTFT, step duration, and per-tool timing offline (see report §5).
- **MBPP fix**: MBPP rows have no `entry_point`; the scripts infer the function name from the first `assert fn(...)` or the reference `def fn`. The old implementation hardcoded `Function name: undefined`, which was the root cause of MBPP behavioral divergence (see report §0 and §6.4).
- Raw bench data is downloaded to `tests/benc

@royenheart/dsh-plugin-opencode-omo README · Latest results (dpsk v4 pro; L1 30×3, corrected L2 5×2, legacy L3 sample)：| level | dsh pass@1 | opencode+omo pass@1 | per-item agreement |
|---|---|---|---|
| HumanEval (30 tasks × 3 repeats) | 1.00 | 1.00 | 1.00 |
| MBPP (corrected entry_point, 5 tasks × 2 repeats) | 1.00 | 1.00 | 1.00 |
| SWE-bench-verified-mini sample (`sphinx-doc__sphinx-10323`) | same patch | same patch | byte-identical git diff |

Full report: `docs/exps/2026-08-15-opencode-omo-equivalence-bench.md`; raw transcripts are under `tests/benches/.runs/`.

@royenheart/dsh-plugin-opencode-omo README · Future alignment harness：Tracking: [#17](https://github.com/royenheart/dsh-plugin-opencode-omo/issues/17).

- **Provenance**: per-combination manifest and content hashes.
- **Deterministic contract**: scripted-catalog prompt/tool rendering compared
  with upstream sections and names.
- **Recorded traces**: record real opencode+omo traces once per pin, then replay
  only this plugin and compare normalized events.

@royenheart/dsh-plugin-opencode-omo README · Alignment status (against the declared baseline)：- **Aligned**: opencode default persona (complete system prompt + live env block whose provider/model follow the same assembly-time route as the request — session live model selection or the role primary/fallback (an in-step fallback retry reuses that assembly while the request route advances); workspace root now derived as the git root); opencode tool families + gpt apply_patch/edit-write tool gating enforced on BOTH the model-visible schema and execution (`tools/pre-execute` deny mirror); opencode maxSteps + verbatim MAX_STEPS_PROMPT; verbatim opencode plan.txt / plan-mode.txt with dynamic `${planInfo}` and the plan→build BUILD_SWITCH reminder; omo role catalog/display names; sisyphus/hephaestus/atlas/sisyphus-junior + specialist subagents; comment-checker/hashline/rules-injector hooks; generated Sisyphus routing sections; extracted omo Sisyphus model-family templates (GPT-5.5/GPT-5.4/claude-opus-4-7/claude-opus-4-8/claude-fable-5/gemini/kimi-k3/kimi-k2-7/kimi-k2-6/glm-5-2, with the dynamic Sisyphus fallback for unknown families) plus hephaestus GPT variants, all 8 atlas variants, and sp

@royenheart/dsh-plugin-opencode-omo README · Remaining gaps：1. **maxSteps role (patched seam + stock fallback)**: `patches/0001` gives the assistant-role request tail on a patched host. A stock 0.2.1 host still gets the same `MAX_STEPS_PROMPT` text and trigger as a system-prompt section, so models may treat the role differently. Tracked upstream as [discussion #2407](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/2407).
2. **dsh-side (proposal, medium)**: `GenerateOptions.format` / `toolChoice`. omo's regular path does not use them; the standalone structured-output plugin covers the common route.
3. Child subagent per-role sampling cannot reliably resolve the role id (dsh child headers/descriptors do not carry it); primary-role sampling defaults ARE applied and children inherit the session model.
4. Plan files: dsh itself does not persist them; the plugin writes `.opencode/plans/*` after `exit_plan_mode` approval. A first-class plan-file seam remains an optional improvement.
5. team-mode TUI, comment-checker CLI, and hashline diff enhancer remain non-LLM/editing experience differences.
